summary: John Perucco, 60, of Illinois, fell ~25 ft from the Zendo Chair at Breckenridge Ski Resort (Peak 6) while brushing snow/ice from his seat soon after loading; safety bar up; landed on hardpack groomer wearing a helmet; died at St. Anthony Summit Hospital. Summit County Sheriff investigation; Colorado Passenger Tramway Safety Board investigated.
responding_agency: Breckenridge Ski Patrol; Summit County Sheriff's Office
notes: Run 740 insert (Summit Daily News chunk, via advnture + UN rewrites of the Summit Daily piece; both URLs parent-opened). Date 2023-03-17 Friday-verified (St. Patrick's Day 2023). Inbounds chairlift fatality — in scope per id 2274 (2022-06-29 Crested Butte chairlift fall) precedent.
